accountDetails.intro: Sena sea hlokahala. Tswela pele ho theha akhaonto ya hao ho {{ server_name }}. O ke ke wa kgona ho fetola sena hamorao.
accountDetails.checking: Ho shejwa hore na lebitso la mosebedisi lea fumaneha …
accountDetails.errorRequired: Sena sea hlokahala. Ka kopo fana ka lebitso la mosebedisi
accountDetails.errorTooLong: Le lelele haholo, ka kopo kgetha le lekgutshwanyane
accountDetails.errorInvalidCharacters: Lebitso la mosebedisi ha le a nepahetsa, ka kopo sebedisa feela {{ allowed_characters }}
accountDetails.errorNotAvailable: {{ username }} ha e fumanehe, ka kopo kgetha e nngwe.
redirectConfirm.title: Tswela pele ho akhaonto ya hao
redirectConfirm.heading: Tswela pele ho akhaonto ya hao
redirectConfirm.trust: Ho tswela pele ho tla fa {{ display_url }} monyetla wa ho kena akhaontong ya hao.
ssoError.title: Ho netefatsa ho hlolehile
ssoError.unauthorised: Ha o a dumellwa ho kena mona.
ssoError.heading: Ho bile le phoso
ssoError.emailLinkHint: Haeba o bona leqephe lena kamora ho tobetsa sehokelo se rometsweng ho wena ka imeile, etsa bonnete ba hore o tobetsa sehokelo sa netefatso hang feela, le hore o bula sehokelo sa netefatso ho moreki ya tshwanang le eo o kenang ho yena.
ssoError.retryHint: Leka ho kena hape ho Pangea Chat mme haeba bothata bo tswela pele ka kopo ikopanye le motsamaisi wa seva.
authSuccess.title: Katleho!
authSuccess.mayClose: Jwale o ka kwala fensetere ena mme wa kgutlela ho kopo
registrationSuccess.title: Netefatso e atlehile
registrationSuccess.body: Dikeledi! Imeile ya hao e netefaditswe. Ka kopo kgutlela ho app ho kena!
passwordResetConfirm.title: Netefatso ya ho seta botjha phasewete
passwordResetConfirm.intro: O kopile ho seta botjha phasewete ya akhaonto ya hao ya Pangea Chat. Tobetsa sehokelo se ka tlase ho netefatsa ketso ena.
passwordResetConfirm.disclaimer: Haeba o ne o sa ikemisetse ho etsa sena, ka kopo kwala leqephe lena mme phasewete ya hao e ke ke ya fetolwa.
passwordResetConfirm.submit: Netefatsa ho fetola phasewete ya ka
